comparison.objective: Seat a graphics card squarely so connector, bracket gap, and far guide engage together; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-feature rigid-part alignment and controlled insertion versus recessed hex-key engagement, counterholding, fine collar rotation, tightening, and iterative cycle testing.
comparison.success_condition: Available body only names the task; title requires simultaneous square engagement, but insertion-force, seating, and damage thresholds are missing. Candidate requires two repeatable bounded stops.
comparison.reason: Both demand precision, but card seating tests constrained multi-axis insertion, while the candidate tests adjustment, locking, and dynamic commissioning.
